clinicalText.diagnosisProblems: Perianal Abscess; Incision and drainage was done under LA
clinicalText.briefDescription: Under local anesthesia, a cruciate incision was made over the point of maximum fluctuance and the abscess cavity was drained of purulent material. The cavity was explored digitally to break loculations, irrigated with saline, and loosely packed with a wick, left open to heal by secondary intention.

clinicalText.diagnosisProblems: Hydrocele; Jaboulay's hydrocelectomy was done under LA
clinicalText.briefDescription: Under local anesthesia, a scrotal incision was made and the tunica vaginalis was delivered and opened, releasing clear straw-colored fluid. The sac was everted behind the testis and cord structures and sutured (Jaboulay's procedure). Hemostasis was secured and the wound was closed in layers.
